title: Memo on mixed display-kit inserts
titleZh: 展示套件說明卡混用備忘錄
passage:
Warehouse memo | Demo-kit inserts

The stockroom has two sets of instruction cards for the folding stand. The old card has a blue stripe. It is still correct for stands packed with the shorter support pin. The new card has a green stripe and gives separate steps for the longer pin.

Do not assign a card by carton age. Some older cartons were reopened to receive longer pins during the May repacking. The check mark beside the carton number in the repacking register means the pin was physically checked; the date the carton was delivered does not give that information.

For a carton without a check mark, leave the card out and move the carton to the inspection bench. If the carton is already sealed for the courier, do not break the seal on the packing line. Ask the dispatch lead to hold it before pickup; inspection will take place after it is returned to the bench.
passageZh:
倉庫備忘錄｜展示套件說明卡

庫房有兩種摺疊展示架的說明卡。藍條紋的是舊卡，配短支撐銷的架子仍適用。綠條紋的是新卡，為長支撐銷提供另一套操作步驟。

不要根據紙箱新舊來分配卡片。五月重新裝箱時，有些舊紙箱被重新打開並換上較長的銷。重新裝箱登記冊上，紙箱編號旁的勾號表示銷已經實際檢查；紙箱送達日期無法提供這項資訊。

紙箱沒有勾號時，先不要放說明卡，並把紙箱移到檢驗台。如果紙箱已封好準備交給快遞，不要在包裝線拆封。請出貨主管在快遞取件前先扣住紙箱，等紙箱送回檢驗台再檢查。
